apps.name: DDG SUPER Canary Probe
apps.subtitle: Probe-only canary; no native Agent UI
apps.localizedDescription: Unsigned DuckDuckGo iOS canary from duckduckgo/apple-browsers tag 7.210.0+ios. v0.4.2 only injects a tiny internal WKUserScript probe. No button, no alert, no overlay. Use only to isolate launch force-close cause.
apps.versionDescription: Probe-only isolation build: no native UI strings/button present; probe marker found in binary. If this launches, prior crash came from native UI overlay route.
